title: Tôi cần báo cáo hành lý thất lạc
englishTitle: I need to report lost luggage
pronunciation: Toi can bao cao hanh ly that lac
summary: For starting a missing-bag report at an airport baggage desk.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Use it with your baggage tag, passport, flight number, or bag photo ready.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say the phrase once, then let the tag or photo carry the detail.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Tôi cần means I need; báo cáo means report; hành lý thất lạc means lost luggage.

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Immigration, baggage-claim, and SIM-card phrases help if you are still finding your way through arrivals.

phrases.english: Where can I buy a SIM card?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at baggage-service counters, airline desks, airport information desks, and transfer desks.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Staff may ask for the tag number, bag description, delivery address, and local phone or email.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Pickup area, driver meetup, missing bag, domestic terminal, and visa phrases cover arrival follow-ups.
